programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Brahms - A German Requiem, Op. 45
programme.desc: In this concert recorded in November 2016 at the magnificent Baroque basilica of Saint Florian, Austria – once the home of Anton Bruckner – the Wiener Singverein, the Cleveland Orchestra and its principal conductor Franz Welser-Möst pare down all traces of bombast wherever emotions could easily run out of control. Brahms' Ein Deutsches Requiem, Op.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Duparc, Schumann a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Geng Lee (China, 1994) and pianist Nils Basters (Germany, 1989) perform Henri Duparc’s Chanson triste; ‘Ein Jüngling liebt ein Mädchen’ and ‘Am leuchtenden Sommermorgen’ from Robert Schumann’s Dichterliebe, Op.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: Mozart - Gran partita
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Serenade No. 10 for winds in B-flat major, K. 361, also known as the ‘Gran Partita’.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Bach – Italian Concerto And Chaconne (arr. Busoni)
programme.desc: Italian classical pianist Costanza Principe (1993) started playing the piano at age 6, making her public debut at age 7. Before long she would be performing as a soloist with numerous prestigious orchestras in Italy, the UK, France, and South America.

programme.title: Couperin - Leçons de ténèbres
programme.desc: The French soprano Hanna Bayodi and the Portuguese Ana Quintans join today the Ricercar Consort. The music is by maestro Couperin ‘le Grand’, who just prior to his death had his printer’s licence renewed in order to be able to publish all his music. However, Couperin’s family neglected to pursue the matter, which resulted in the loss of six sets of leçons de ténèbres, among other things. Fortunately, three sets were preserved.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: The Divan Orchestra from the Alhambra
programme.desc: Millions of television viewers in Germany, France, Portugal, Greece and Finland experienced live the moving open-air concert within the highly symbolic surrounding of the Alhambra in Granada. Music as a language of peace – this vision unifies the young musicians of the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra who come from Israel, Palestine, Syria, Jordan, Egypt and Europe.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 6 in D major
programme.desc: For the 2016 edition of the Waldbühne, the Georgian violinist Lisa Batiashvili and the Québécois conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin join the Berliner Philharmoniker for a beautiful concert. They present an all Czech program!

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Le Sacre: A ballet in two parts by Uwe Scholz
programme.desc: Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the 20th century, created two interpretations of Igor Stravinsky’s Le Sacre du Printemps for the Leipzig Ballet. Sacre I, for one dancer, can be interpreted as a bleak and oppressive dance about Scholz’ own life. This unique solo is performed by Giovanni Di Palma to the four-handed piano version.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1997 - St. Petersburg White Night
programme.desc: The 1997 edition of the Waldbühne concert is dedicated to Russian composers. The Berliner Philharmoniker, directed by Zubin Mehta, kicks off the evening with the opening of Mikhail Glinka's opera Ruslan and Ludmila, after which Daniel Barenboim takes center stage to perform Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 and Chopin's Waltz in D flat major, op. 64 No. 1.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Gerd Albrecht conducts the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s “Prague” Symphony No. 38 (K. 504). The work was composed by Mozart in late 1786 and premiered in January 1787, during the composer’s first visit to Prague, hence the nickname “Prague”.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Bach - Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2 No. 1 to 12
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Debussy, Messiaen a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sara Gouzy (France, 1991) and pianist Seri Dan (South Korea, 1992) perform ‘Chevaux de bois’ from Claude Debussy’s Ariettes oubliées, L. 63; Franz Schubert’s An den Mond, Op. 57, No. 3, D. 193; ‘Le collier’ from Olivier Messiaen’s Poèmes pour Mi; ‘Margaritki’ (Daisies) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; ‘Quelle aventure!

programme.title: The Violin's Voice
programme.desc: How can we describe the intimate connection between an instrument and its player? World renowned violinist Frank Peter Zimmerman refers to his 1711 Stradivarius 'Lady Inchiquin' as the 'love of his life,' but what does it take for a piece of wood to achieve such reverential status?

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Bernhard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1. Directed by Barry Gavin, this concert took place at the Berliner Philharmonie in 1992. Mahler was inspired by Jean Paul’s novel Titan, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Von Zemlinsky - Clarinet Trio, Op. 3
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Jorge Gaona Ros (clarinet), Ksenia Kouzmenko (piano) and René Geesing (cello) plays Von Zemlinsky’s Klarinet Trio, Op. 3. It was recorded in Concordia, Enschede, on February 18, 2018. Zemlinsky was born in Vienna of a Slovak father and Sarajevan mother and studied at the Vienna Conservatoire. In his early twenties, his chamber work was performed at the Wiener Tonkünstlerverein.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - I. L'Adoration de la Terre
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Big Nightmare Music
programme.desc: Russian violinist, conductor and composer Aleksey Igudesman and British-Korean pianist and composer Hyung-ki Joo started their dynamic duo in 2004, when they created their show “A Little Nightmare Music,” a humorous take on Mozart’s “Eine Kleine Nachtmusik.” Since then, they have been performing at international festivals and touring internationally, often collaborating with artists from within and outside of the classical genre.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 9 can be seen as a farewell to life. Even as Bruckner began working on it in 1887, his health had begun to fail. He expressed the hope that 'God will grant me enough time to complete it,' and worked on it assiduously over the next years. But by late 1894 he had completed only the first three movements. When he died on 11 October 1896, he left six different versions of the finale, all of them incomplete.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2010 - Oxford
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885.

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Semi Final I - Liszt Competition 2017
programme.desc: Sergey Belyavskiy (1993, Russia) performs Rapsodie hongroise No. 9 ‘Carnival in Pest’, S244/9 and Grandes Études de Paganini, S141 during semi-final I (transcription) of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: Verdi - Otello
programme.desc: Based on a story by William Shakespeare, the Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi wrote the opera Otello. Stage director David Alden created his version of this tragedy for the Teatro Real, in Madrid. Renato Palumbo conducts the orchestra and chorus of the Teatro Real. The performance also features Gregory Kunde, Ermonela Jaho, and George Petean. Othello, the Venetian governor of Cyprus, returns to the island after a victorious campaign.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Amigos para sempre T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Eren, Seda, Merve e Yunus são quatro amigos que se conheceram há um ano, quando estudavam na universidade. No primeiro ano de aula, Seda conhece seu amigo de infância Gizem. Seda e Gizem, desde o primeiro momento se unem como antigamente estavam ligados um ao outro. Porém, os equilíbrios do grupo começam a mudar em breve.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: J.E. 'Cannonball' Adderley live in Switzerland
programme.desc: Cannonball Adderley: Live in '63 boasts two beautifully filmed concerts from one of the most celebrated sextets in jazz history, captured at the top of their game.

programme.title: Free Improvisation 2
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Morenika
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Fay Claassen: Two Portraits of Chet Baker
programme.desc: In 2013 it is 25 years ago that singer and trumpet player Chet Baker mysteriously died, caused by a fall from the window of his hotel room in Amsterdam. His music is more popular than ever. This concert is performed by Fay Claassen, who became internationally known through her album ‘Two Portraits of Chet Baker’. In the U.S. this album was the ‘Best Vocal Album of the Year’.

programme.title: Dionne Warwick live at the 27 Club
programme.desc: Dionne Warwick’s vocal artistry ranges from voluminous deep register to soft, fragile high notes. She masters the entire range with almost unnerving ease. But more than her strong, warm voice, Dionne’s magic is in the silky elegance and the secure delivery with which she tells a story.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Free And Afro Jazz
programme.desc: The term 'jam-session' was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call 'jammin 'the beat'.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Libérica Arrels
programme.desc: Having played in New York with jazz icons Dave Liebman, Eliot Zigmund, Ari Hoenig, and Chris Cheek, Catalan bass player Manel Fortià now returns to his roots to reinvent traditional Catalan repertoire. Manel Fortià teams up with Antonia Lizana (saxophones), Pere Martínez (vocals), Max Villavecchia (piano), and Raphael Pannier (drums) to form ‘Libérica’, reimagining Catalan music and Flamenco through the eyes of a New York jazz musician.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jacques Kuba Séguin: L'étude des Lueurs
programme.desc: Trumpeter Jacques Kuba Séguin’s ensemble unites some of Montreal’s most expressive musicians: apart from Jacques Kuba Séguin, double bassist Frédéric Alarie, pianist Jonathan Cayer, and drummer Kevin Warren deliver subtle but strong lyrical moments, that make it hard not to be touched by the musical bond of this group. The experience of their ‘Litania Projekt’ seems to stop time for an instant.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: TorTube: Robin Nolan Trio - Swing de Paris
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2023, jazzahead!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2022 - Fergus McCreadie
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead!

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part III
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again
programme.desc: Lex Jasper Trio: Happy Days Are Here Again - the title says is all… After an automobile accident and 15 years of revalidation, he is back! Together with his musical pals Edwin Corzilius (double bass) and Frits Landesbergen (drums), pianist and composer Lex Jasper celebrates his return to jazz club The Duke in the Dutch village of Nistelrode.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Oh Purity in Watching Landscapes
programme.desc: This documentary shows a song cycle by the Danish singer-songwriter Trinelise Væring and pianist Jonas Berg, featuring the Scandinavian Barokksolistene ensemble headed by solo violinist and artistic director Bjarte Eike.

programme.title: Lorrèn at the North Sea Jazz Club: Shades of Blue
programme.desc: With her relaxed, bright voice, vocalist Lorrèn has made her name on the Dutch jazz scene. Lorrèn grew up in a family of music fans: from a very early age, she developed a fondness for the music of her great jazz heroine, Ella Fitzgerald. Also Selah Sue, Adele and Amy Winehouse influenced this wonderful soul, jazz, and pop singer. Lorrèn knows how to transport her audience to infinity with her contemporary music stamp.

programme.title: Jong Metropole live at Radio Kootwijk
programme.desc: Jong Metropole (Young Metropole) is a unique collaboration between the Dutch Metropole Orchestra, the National Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands and the National Jazz Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands. It aims to prepare talented, young musicians in classical and light music for a professional career.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Kaisa's Machine
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Chicken
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Now You Has Jazz
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald in Brussels: The American Songbook
programme.desc: ‘Ella Fitzgerald: Live in '57’ features ‘The First Lady Of Song’ in a distinct performance. It's the earliest known complete concert of Ella to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium, this 1957 concert sees her performing with jazz greats Ray Brown, Herb Ellis, Jo Jones and the legendary Oscar Peterson on classics such as ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’ and ‘It Don’t Mean A Thing (If It Ain’t Got That Swing)’.

programme.title: Andre Marques - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques.

programme.title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor And soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year’s Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Katché And Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Baas And van Gelder
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Daoud
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Morgenland: Songs Without Frontiers
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Sun-Mi Hong Quintet - jazzahead!
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts. Due to COVID-19, only half of the scheduled performances of the 2021 edition were actually recorded in Bremen.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Saxkartel
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ.tv Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by Saxkartel.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: Relaxamento Noturno
programme.desc: Tempo para relaxar e descontrair com sons e imagens da natureza que acalmam e transmitem uma sensação de tranquilidade. Pode ser um bom momento para adormecer ou simplesmente contemplar e descansar.

programme.title: Estímulo Noturno
programme.desc: Espaço para exercitar o corpo e a mente através de conteúdos animados e movimentos divertidos de objectos, pessoas e animais. O objectivo é incentivar o cão a mexer-se e captar a sua atenção para os efeitos rápidos que passam no ecrã.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: This episode features heavyweights Tomasz Adamek (217 lbs 40- 1- 0) vs. Chris Arreola (250? lbs. 28- 1- 0) from the Citizens Business Bank Arena, Ontario, California, USA on April 24, 2010.

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 49
programme.desc: In this episode, the newly crowned IBF Lightweight World Champion, Shane Mosley, makes the first defense of the title he claimed from Phillip Holiday just three months earlier. He would face a tough competitor in Manuel Gomez of Laredo, Mexico, who would give the new champion a difficult test.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 37
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Jhonny Gonzalez defending the WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa. A left hook to the body ends the fight. Also on the card, a controversial ending to the Nate Campbell / Ali Funeka brawl.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T26 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. From the Ryogoku Kokugikan Arena in Tokyo, Japan, Show 2 features Kagayaki, Asanoyama, Daieisho and Aoiyama.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: This episode features a Light Welterweight title bout between the unbeaten Danny Garcia and #1 contender Amir Khan, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Serena aceita a proposta de Rafael. Clarice dá conselhos para Generosa. Felipe e Mirella se encontram escondidos. Cristina segue os conselhos de Débora. Rafael é surpreendido.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 119

programme.title: First Time Fixer T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um acidente com a máquina de lavar loiça numa casa de Washington, leva agentes imobiliários a transformá-la numa casa de campo com um baixo orçamento.

programme.title: Island Life T11 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Famílias, casais e pessoas sozinhas decidem cumprir o seu sonho de viver numa ilha. Conseguirão encontrar a casa dos seus sonhos no local perfeito?.

programme.desc: Famílias, casais e pessoas sozinhas decidem cumprir o seu sonho de viver numa ilha. Conseguirão encontrar a casa dos seus sonhos no local perfeito?.

programme.desc: A equipa investiga o estranho caso do desaparecimento do iate de luxo ‘Saba Bank’ próximo da região, em 1974.

programme.title: A Construção De Um Imperio T1 - Ep. 10

programme.title: A Construção De Um Imperio T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Durante mais de 4.000 anos, surgiram e desapareceram grandes impérios por todo o mundo. Apenas um resistiu ao tempo: A China. .

programme.title: A Construção De Um Imperio T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: No auge do seu poder, este império estendeu-se ao longo de territórios que compreendiam 15 fusos horários, englobou quase 160 etnias diferentes e abarcou uma sexta parte do território da Terra.

programme.title: Os Caçadores De Mistérios T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Explore connosco o mistério em torno da origem das caveiras de cristal que tanta especulação sobrenatural suscita. Intrigantes, misteriosas e inquietantes, são autênticas obras de arte.

programme.title: Os Caçadores De Mistérios T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Explore connosco a história da misteriosa ilha de Rapa Nui. Qual o significado e a origem das suas estátuas em pedra? A sua existência é um prodígio do engenho humano.

programme.title: Os Caçadores De Mistérios T1 - Ep. 12

Quando terroristas tentam assumir o controle de um voo Berlim-Paris, um co-piloto americano de fala mansa luta para salvar a vida dos passageiros e da tripulação enquanto forja uma conexão surpreendente com um dos sequestradores.

programme.title: American Pie: O Reencontro
programme.desc: Todas as personagens de ´American Pie´ regressam a East Great Falls para uma reunião de colegas do liceu. Num longo fim-de-semana descobrem o que mudou, o que não mudou e que o tempo e a distância não quebra os laços da amizade.

programme.title: Plano de Fuga
programme.desc: Ray Breslin, especialista em estruturas de segurança, aceita um desafio: fugir de uma instalação ultra-secreta e de alta tecnologia, ´O Túmulo´. Mas uma vez prisioneiro, Breslin descobre que foi enganado e é considerado como um preso de verdade.

programme.title: Hollywood News Feed
programme.desc: As novidades, os gossips das suas estrelas favoritas de Hollywood.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Em Chamas
programme.desc: Depois de Katniss Everdeen e Peeta Mellark se sagrarem vencedores dos Jogos da Fome, os jovens percorrerem os 12 Distritos, em eventos oficiais. Katniss apercebe-se de um sentimento de revolta, que lhe alimenta a esperança numa rebelião.

programme.title: Uma Boa Pessoa
programme.desc: Segue Allison, cuja vida se desmorona após o seu envolvimento num acidente fatal.

programme.title: Harry Potter e Os Talismãs da Morte - Part 2
programme.desc: Harry Potter precisa de se apresentar para fazer o seu último sacrifício, enquanto o confronto final com Lord Voldemort se aproxima. Tudo acaba aqui.

programme.title: Evereste
programme.desc: Inspirado na história verídica de uma expedição ao cume do Evereste, que terminou em tragédia quando os alpinistas foram apanhados de surpresa por uma violenta tempestade de neve.

programme.title: Ligação de Alto Risco
programme.desc: Uma mulher vítima de sequestro consegue contactar o telemóvel de um homem que se lança sozinho nesta aventura e que irá tentar salvá-la.

programme.title: Velocidade Mortal
programme.desc: Ben Aronoff é um campeão de corridas de barcos, multimilionário, que leva uma vida dupla como traficante de droga. Mas esta sua vida secreta irá deixá-lo num fogo cruzado entre a Lei e a Máfia...

programme.title: The Revenant: O Renascido
programme.desc: Numa expedição pelo desconhecido território americano, o explorador Hugh Glass é brutalmente atacado por um urso e deixado à morte pelos companheiros. Mas Glass resiste a um sofrimento inimaginável e enfrenta um inverno rigoroso em busca de vingança.

programme.title: Guerra
programme.desc: Jack Crawford, um agente do FBI, jura travar Rogue, um misterioso assassino que fez despolotar uma violenta guerra entre as mafias asiáticas.

programme.title: Noite em Fuga
programme.desc: Jimmy Conlon, um mafioso assassino de Brooklyn já viu melhores dias. Amigo de longa data do chefe da máfia, Jimmy, atualmente com 55 anos, é perseguido pelos erros do passado e por um obstinado detetive da polícia, que o procura há 30 anos.

programme.title: Contra Todas as Regras
programme.desc: Depois de uma ilustre carreira nas operações especiais terminar em desastre, Alexander retira-se e leva uma vida tranquila. Mas quando a sua família fica na mira de um gangster russo, Alexander é arrastado para uma guerra entre gangues rivais.

programme.title: Força Destruidora
programme.desc: Frank Dux, um perito em Ninjitsu determinado em honrar o legado do seu mestre moribundo, vê-se forçado a atravessar meio mundo para travar um brutal combate de full-contact.

programme.title: Assassino Americano
programme.desc: O gangster americano Erik Vasquez está a planear tornar-se o chefe do submundo mexicano, mas acaba por fazer inimigos tanto nos poderosos cartéis como nos seus próprios aliados.

programme.title: A Invasão
programme.desc: Uma psicóloga de Washington tenta encontrar o seu filho na altura em que um vírus oriundo de outro planeta despoja os humanos dos seus sentimentos.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky é um experiente burlão que reencontra Jess, a quem ensinou todos os seus truques. Envolvida no mundo das altas apostas de corridas de carros a ex aluna vai envolver-se no mais recente, e perigoso, esquema de Nicky, para deixar o mestre fora de jogo.

programme.title: A Supremacia dos Robots
programme.desc: A Terra foi conquistada por Robots de uma Galáxia distante, que vieram para avaliar e observar a raça humana. Os sobreviventes ficam confinados às suas casas e a usar implantes eletrónicos, ameaçando com incineração os que não respeitem as suas ordens.

programme.title: A-X-L: Uma Amizade Extraordinária

programme.desc: ISTO É O POVO A FALAR' é um programa de entrevista e reportagem que aborda assuntos controversos e atuais vividos na sociedade portuguesa. Trata-se de um programa feito a pensar no Povo Português, em prol da sua dignidade e da proteção dos seus direitos enquanto cidadãos.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 56
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 57

programme.title: A Rota T9 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Vidas Transformadas T5 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Vidas Transformadas é um programa baseado em testemunhos reais do que Deus está a fazer na vida das pessoas.

programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.

programme.title: Maná World T2 - Ep. 62

programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as mulheres que desejam conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, temas diversificados que a vão prender ao ecra.

programme.title: Un chef au bout du monde avec Philippe Etchebest
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest part à la découverte de l’Australie, une île-continent aux horizons immenses, grande comme quinze fois la France, taillée pour l’ampleur. Un pays peuplé de créatures uniques au monde, où tout n’est que démesure. Des fermes de l’outback aux canaux de lave aborigènes, des étals saisonniers de Melbourne à une île perdue au large de la Tasmanie, dans ces espaces sans limites, Philippe part à la rencontre de celles et...

programme.title: Un chef au bout du monde avec Philippe Etchebest
programme.desc: Le chef Philippe Etchebest se lance dans un road trip à travers la Californie, l’État le plus peuplé des États-Unis et le premier état d’immigration. À l’heure où une partie du pays semble se refermer sur elle-même avec l’élection de Donald Trump pour un second mandat, ce voyage devient une exploration des identités et des cultures qui façonnent l’Amérique. Depuis San Francisco, en passant par Los Angeles et San Diego, Philippe part...

programme.title: Scènes de ménages
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

programme.title: À quel prix? la suite
programme.desc: Pouvoir d’achat en baisse, inflation, arbitrages permanents : pour meubler, ranger ou décorer leur intérieur, les Français traquent désormais le moindre bon plan. Tout doit être utile, rapide à acheter, dans l’air du temps, mais surtout peu cher. Dans ce contexte, les enseignes de décoration se livrent une bataille acharnée. Promotions, arrivages, logistique, implantation des rayons, nouveaux concepts : derrière les étiquettes...

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une...

programme.title: Cauchemar en cuisine
programme.desc: Le chef Etchebest vient en aide à Stéphanie et Julien. Ce couple a repris un restaurant il y a seulement 7 mois mais Stéphanie et Julien sont aujourd’hui dans une situation désastreuse qui affecte tout le monde, y compris leurs enfants. Il y a donc urgence à intervenir. En les observant, le chef est, comme d’habitude, rapidement confronté à un manque de professionnalisme flagrant ! Face à cette situation et une ambiance...

programme.title: Cauchemar en cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest se rend à Brive-la-Gaillarde pour venir en aide à Amina, restauratrice depuis 35 ans. Si pendant des années son restaurant a été un succès, aujourd'hui Amina est complètement dépassée et son établissement est passé de 200 couverts par jour à... 2 ! Le chef va découvrir un laisser-aller incroyable et l'une des cuisines les plus grasses qu'il ait jamais vues, l'obligeant même à s'équiper pour inspecter les lieux !...

programme.desc: When a singer disappears during a serial killer spree, a taxidriver and a businessman's son cross paths in a disturbing tale where the lines between good and evil are blurred.

programme.desc: This is the story about Ramji, who is a skilled cook and flies to London to try his luck in work. It is the story about his journey and life in London.

programme.title: Sirf Ek Bandaa Kaafi Hai
programme.desc: A common man with honesty and integrity can take on the system when he has truth on his side.

programme.title: Time To Dance
programme.desc: When a ballroom dancer's shot at a crucial tournament is jeopardized, a street dancer must face his own painful past and step up as her new partner.

programme.title: Looop Lapeta
programme.desc: When her boyfriend loses a mobster's cash, Savi races against the clock to save the day if only she can break out of a curious cycle of dead ends.

programme.title: Street Dancer 3D
programme.desc: Two rival dance groups, Street Dancer and Rule Breakers, despise each other and participate in a dance battle. Later, they decide to join hands for a greater cause.

programme.title: Aashiqui (1990)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer meets a beautiful woman unexpectedly in a police station. He chases after her and eventually they start dating each other, but they have to deal with many problems thereafter.

programme.title: Gumraah
programme.desc: The murder investigation into a young man's death takes an unexpected turn when the cops discover that the prime suspect has a lookalike.

programme.title: Sardar Udham Singh
programme.desc: The life of Sardar Udham Singh, a revolutionary freedom fighter best known for assassinating Michael O'Dwyer in London to take revenge for 1919 Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar.

programme.title: Phir Aayi Hasseen Dillruba
programme.desc: Escaping from the police in Agra, Rani and Rishu decide to elope together. When their plan goes awry, Rani seeks a helping hand from a kind admirer.

programme.desc: The life of Maj. Sandeep Unnikrishnan, who fought against terrorists and was killed in action during the 2008 attacks at the Taj Palace Hotel in Mumbai, India.

programme.title: Befikre

programme.title: Malang

programme.title: Sardar Ka Grandson
programme.desc: A devoted grandson embarks on a complicated and comic journey to fulfill his ailing grandmother's last wish.

programme.title: Srikanth
programme.desc: In a world where the odds are against him, Srikanth defies the norms and makes his way from rural India to becoming the first visually impaired student at MIT.

programme.title: Panipat
programme.desc: When Ahmad Shah Abdali, the king of Afghanistan, announces war, the army chief of the Marathas, Gets ready for the battle by overcoming several obstacles.

programme.title: Nehlle Pe Dehlla
programme.desc: Two small-time crooks, Jimmy and Johny, blackmail hotel manager Balram Sahni aka Ballu in order to get a huge sum of money. But their plan goes haywire when Ballu is mysteriously murdered.

programme.title: Savi
programme.desc: Savi a simple housewife attempts a daring jailbreak to get her husband out of one of high security prisons With 400 inmates, 75 armed guards, 60 surveillance cameras.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T12 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz estão a caminho dos condados domésticos, onde têm à sua espera um Ford Popular de 1955. Contudo, este não é um clássico vulgar, mas sim um hot-rod altamente modificado com um motor V8 brutal e uma série de problemas. O carro já foi a menina dos olhos de Andy, que sofre de paralisia cerebral, mas com tantos problemas mecânicos o seu adorado Pop tem estado a apanhar pó na garagem sem qualquer chance de voltar à estrada.

programme.title: SOS Automóvel T12 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Tim e Fuzz restauram um Datsun Skyline, um clássico japonês dos anos 70. Com apenas outros dois exemplares na estrada, este é um dos carros mais raros em que a dupla já trabalhou.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Aproveite esta impressionante oportunidade de ver como se produz um Ford Mustang, onde são feitas quatro versões diferentes, incluindo o super poderoso V8 de 650 cavalos.

programme.title: Mega Fábricas T5 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Em 2011, quase uma década depois do lançamento do Murcielago, a Lamborghini lança a sua criação mais recente - o Aventador. Com uma velocidade máxima de 350km/h e manobrabilidade melhorada, este carro é um símbolo da nova era da Lamborghini. Veja a história por detrás da ideia e conceito até ao produto final, acompanhando o incrível processo de produção, num edifício de tamanho impressionante, inteiramente dedicado ao Aventador.

programme.title: Mayday, Desastres Aéreos T25 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando o trem de aterragem falha, os pilotos de um turboélice da Nova Zelândia realizam uma notável aterragem de barriga que salva a vida de todos a bordo e causa danos mínimos à aeronave. Ao investigar o que correu mal, os especialistas descobrem um problema sistémico que está a pôr passageiros em risco em todo o mundo.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Aviões congelados, uma assistente de voo ferida e um intruso embriagado mantêm a equipa em alerta máximo quando uma grande onda de frio atinge o Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma emergência na pista, carga desaparecida, travões avariados e animais na pista – no Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto, a luta para manter os voos em movimento nunca tem fim.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um avião aterra de emergência no Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto. O consequente encerramento do aeroporto faz com que voos sejam cancelados e desviados, testando os limites das equipas.

programme.title: Mayday, Desastres Aéreos T25 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um avião turboélice fora de controlo desintegra-se durante uma tentativa de aterragem no aeroporto de Düsseldorf, matando instantaneamente todos os ocupantes. Os investigadores alemães localizam todos os destroços no local do acidente e, após uma meticulosa reconstrução da fuselagem, descobrem provas de uma falha extremamente rara que nunca deveria ter feito cair o avião.

programme.title: Imundícies Preciosas T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando a fornalha, que fornece energia ao seu fumador, se avaria, toda a operação de Ray fica estagnada. No Louisiana, os rapazes do bayou, David LaGrange, Keith e Seth Major estão no encalce de um aligátore gigante que lhes tem andado a roubar o isco e a dar um prejuízo de milhares de dólares.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Dinamarca revela uma central elétrica com uma pista de esqui como telhado, casas tradicionais feitas de zostera e uma nova conexão europeia.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Sérvia revela um arranha-céus recorde, uma maneira única de colher pimentos e um esforço especial de conservação animal.

programme.title: Europa Vista De Cima T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma viagem aérea sobre a Bélgica mostra um edifício em forma de cristal de ferro, a limpeza da maior igreja do país e um evento de luzes que acontece a cada três anos.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O astrólogo Nostradamus escreveu centenas de versos enigmáticos que parecem prever acontecimentos futuros. Segundo a lenda, o Castelo de Houska guarda um portal para o inferno e foi ali que o poeta Mácha teve uma visão aterradora do futuro. Na Itália medieval, São Francisco de Assis afirmou ter vivido o primeiro caso de estigmas, acreditando ter recebido as chagas de Cristo.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: As visões de Rasputine e a sua alegada capacidade de cura valeram-lhe uma reputação que o levou ao círculo íntimo do último czar e a um lugar nas páginas da história. Na China, estudiosos procuram decifrar os segredos de uma escrita antiga e de um sistema de adivinhação. Em Point Pleasant, na Virgínia Ocidental, uma misteriosa criatura alada foi avistada pouco antes do colapso trágico de uma ponte.

programme.title: Profecias Da História T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Na China do século XIV, o brilhante Liu Bowen coloca os seus talentos e profecias ao serviço de uma dinastia em ascensão. Depois de se declarar ditador de Roma, Júlio César recebe uma profecia inquietante. Porque é que não deu ouvidos aos avisos? Na Escócia, a família nobre Erskine recebe uma profecia que os persegue como uma maldição durante gerações.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Há apenas alguns dias restantes da caça ao veado nas Blue Ridge Mountains da Carolina do Norte e os caseiros Tony e Amelia precisam de carne para os sustentar pelo Inverno. Mas Tony nunca caçou veado e não tem o luxo do tempo para aperfeiçoar os seus métodos. Tony entra diretamente na caçada e a pressão começa.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Estamos na temporada das armadilhas e Colbert tem que meter mãos à obra. Vender peles de castor na cidades dar-lhe-á o grosso do dinheiro para pagar os impostos dos seus terrenos e servirá para comprar itens pequenos que não consegue arranjar no pântano. O caçador-coletor Matt tenta caçar coelhos com o seu arco e flecha caseiro.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os caseiros Tony e Amelia começam a construção de um desidratador solar para preservar a abundância de carne de veado. Com o seu design a existir apenas na mente de Tony, o par tem que juntar vários materiais reciclados e reaproveitados para construir o aparato de uma maneira que capitalize toda a energia solar que consegue. A falta de recursos por perto força o caçador-coletor Matt a deixar a sua casa em busca de pastos mais verdes.

programme.title: Liberdade Ou Morte T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Após abandonar a sua antiga casa devido à falta de recursos, o caçador-recolector Matt viaja até aos desfiladeiros de elevação inferior do sul do Utah para encontrar um novo local para chamar de casa. Ele tem esperança que esta terra tenha os recursos necessários para sobreviver nos meses frios. O Inverno chegou finalmente portanto Matt tem que trabalhar rapidamente para construir um abrigo permanente para se proteger dos elementos.

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dois reclusos normais no Centro de Detenção do Condado de Clark, em Las Vegas, estão a ter dificuldades com o vício. Ambos estão desesperados por uma segunda oportunidade e enfrentarão as provas da Cidade .

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T3 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Para três reclusos do Centro de Detenção do Condado de Clark, a prisão é um jogo de espera - um relógio a contar em cima das suas cabeças que os levará ou a mais tempo na prisão ou à vida de volta nas ruas. Em Vegas, sair da prisão é, por vezes, a parte fácil. Mas manter-se fora é uma história muito diferente. Com nada além de tempo, os reclusos são forçados a escolher se querem continuar no mesmo caminho ou mudar de vida..

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Las Vegas é um oásis de trabalho e diversão, quer legais quer ilegais. Desrespeite a lei e será enviado para o Centro de Detenção do condado de Clark, a principal prisão da cidade do pecado. Quando os reclusos cumprem pena na prisão, a família cumpre pena cá fora. Alguns reclusos libertam-se do que os aprisiona em termos mentais e físicos e voltam às suas famílias. Outros sucumbem aos vícios e voltam à estaca zero..

programme.title: Penas Pesadas: Dilemas E Consequências T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: No centro de detenção de Clark Country, em Las Vegas, mais de mil reclusos dão entrada sob o efeito de drogas, com doenças mentais ou ambos. Por vezes é impossível ignorar que este estabelecimento será também um centro de reabilitação para toxicodependentes e um hospital psiquiátrico. Estes reclusos não são só um problema para a cadeia, são também da sua responsabilidade.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Técnicos de prevenção de avalanches correm para reparar uma estação meteorológica remota antes de uma tempestade iminente. O aumento dos riscos obriga-os a uma missão de bombardeamento para eliminar uma acumulação perigosa de neve sobre a Klondike Highway. Entretanto, Dawson City fica em choque com a perda da pessoa em quem mais confiavam para os manter seguros.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A Civil Air Search and Rescue Association do Yukon enfrenta condições de voo traiçoeiras na investigação de um avião histórico desaparecido. O Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City responde a uma chamada de emergência que coloca a cidade em risco, enquanto dois dos seus elementos ficam em apuros longe de casa. Depois, um pedido de ajuda leva Ray às zonas mais remotas do Yukon.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City corre para proteger a cidade de inundações repentinas e devastadoras. Os guardas-florestais perseguem uma manada de bisontes perigosa, têm um encontro com um urso e montam uma operação para apanhar um pescador furtivo reincidente. Ray e Doug enfrentam um lamaçal ao resgatar o veículo avariado de um caçador.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O guarda-florestal Logan apanha um grande susto ao investigar um caso de caça ilegal, e um urso-pardo agressivo devasta a cabana remota de um caçador. Ray entra em ação quando um condutor adormece ao volante, e uma nova geração de recrutas da Yukon First Nations Wildfire é posta à prova quando um incêndio ameaça Whitehorse.

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Quando um urso investe contra um grupo de investigadores num local remoto, um guarda-florestal enfrenta uma situação potencialmente fatal. Mais tarde, o Corpo de Bombeiros de Dawson City dá resposta ao acidente de um rapaz num trilho de BTT e a uma colisão numa ravina, antes de ser homenageado pelo Chefe Mike e por toda a cidade pelo seu serviço.

programme.title: Tsunami: Corrida Contra O Tempo T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um tsunami atinge o Sri Lanka. A mais de 1000 milhas do epicentro do terramoto, as ondas destroem um comboio e cidades costeiras. Os médicos lutam para salvar todas as vidas que podem. À medida que o desastre se espalha por todo o Oceano Índico, os jornalistas correm para dar a notícia ao mundo e as pessoas acordam para a realidade devastadora de que os seus entes queridos foram arrastados.

programme.title: Tsunami: Corrida Contra O Tempo T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No rescaldo do tsunami mais mortífero da história, os turistas ficam retidos numa ilha devastada pela força das ondas. Com centenas de vítimas, os sobreviventes, oriundos de todos os cantos do mundo têm de trabalhar em conjunto para salvar vidas. Contra todas as probabilidades, conseguem efetuar alguns dos salvamentos mais miraculosos do dia.

programme.title: Bastidores: Aeroporto De Toronto T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma grande tempestade atinge o Aeroporto Internacional de Toronto. As equipas correm contra o tempo para remover a neve e deslocar um Boeing 787 atravessado na pista, que está a causar o caos nas portas de embarque.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Novas imagens coloridas e testemunhos revelam o verdadeiro preço pago pelos Aliados e pelos civis para libertar a Bélgica e os Países Baixos da ocupação nazi.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No final de 1944, Hitler obriga os americanos a travarem a maior e mais sangrenta batalha da guerra, quando lança um ataque surpresa à Bélgica já livre do domínio nazi.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Imagens coloridas únicas e testemunhos orais revelam o custo da libertação da Europa Ocidental no último ano da Segunda Guerra Mundial.
